scope: Frozen exactdiff money/order review; no source/index edits, test reruns or economic run

findings.title: CLI disables required original overlay
findings.problem: Conditional CLI replaces candidate with sol_overlay_enabled=False, but conditional constructor requires True. The economic launch fails before running; original overlay cannot remain enabled.
findings.minimum_correction: Exclude conditional from overlay-disable condition; add runner-built config regression proving original overlay enabled and constructor accepted.

findings.title: Original half-to-full exit decision index is lost
findings.problem: Both ownership release and native physical SOL_EXIT can fulfill logical SOL_HALF_EXIT without calling on_half_exit_decision. Wrapper checks physical intent action, so sol_half_decision_index stays None. Original subsequent full z exit is then permanently blocked despite half_done.
findings.minimum_correction: Record original logical half completion with applied decision index after release/native/mixed fulfillment, without inventing a fill. Regress causal half then later full domain decisions for all fulfillment routes.

findings.title: Later first native fill overwrites assignment-time sigma
findings.problem: Transferred original ownership starts first_owned_at/fixed_sigma but leaves first_fill_at None. A later native original add sets first_fill_at and fixed_sigma together, replacing the ownership cycle original decision sigma and altering its z exits.
findings.minimum_correction: Record first native fill time separately while preserving existing ownership-cycle fixed_sigma until original flat. Regress transfer under sigma A followed by native add under sigma B.
